facts.text: Cal State LA's Early Entrance Program allows qualified gifted students between ages 11 and 15 to enroll as full-time students in the Honors College.

sources.title: Early Entrance Program | Cal State LA
sources.quote: Established in 1982, the program allows gifted students to enroll as full-time students in the Honors College at Cal State LA.

sources.title: Early Entrance Program | Cal State LA
sources.quote: Qualified students between the ages of 11-15 matriculate as college students, joining our existing population of gifted students.
